card.line: Cyrene was a Greek city in North Africa with many Jews. People from there appear at the cross, at Pentecost, and in the early church.

moments.title: Simon carries the cross
moments.text: Soldiers forced Simon of Cyrene, who was coming in from the country, to carry the cross of Jesus. Mark says he was the father of Alexander and Rufus.

moments.title: Cyrene at Pentecost
moments.text: People from the parts of Libya near Cyrene were in Jerusalem when the Spirit came. They heard the wonders of God declared in their own languages.

moments.title: Good news at Antioch
moments.text: Some men from Cyprus and Cyrene went to Antioch and spoke about the Lord Jesus to the Greeks too. The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed.

moments.title: Lucius leads at Antioch
moments.text: Lucius of Cyrene was one of the prophets and teachers in the church at Antioch. While they worshiped, the Holy Spirit called Barnabas and Saul to be sent out.
